summary: Large Studio Apartment · Excellent Jesmond location · Great Access To City Centre & RVI · Available 1st August
description:
A modern studio apartment set in an excellent Jesmond location.

My Property Box are delighted to welcome back to the market this recently refurbished, large studio apartment located on Eskdale Terrace, Jesmond. Located on the second floor, the apartment comes fully furbished with bespoke bed/storage unit, flat screen TV and recently refurbished kitchen, alongside bathroom. Available from 1st August, the apartment is ideal for a tenant who desires quick access to both Jesmond & Newcastle City Centre.

To arrange a viewing please contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
